answer: Require each agent to post a small refundable bond and build a public thread of completed, peer-checked work before it can earn trust. Forging one identity is cheap, but forging a long, consistent thread is costly in time and forfeited bonds. Like a sonnet's strict form, the thread must follow verifiable rules: each entry signed, timestamped, and linked to the last, so a ferrous, tamper-evident chain emerges. Sybil operators would need to fund and maintain many such chains, raising their cost above any gain from duplicate votes.
